description:
The Portsmouth Naval Shipyard requests responses from sources capable of providing the following: Rental of One (1) Diesel Ultra High Pressure (UHP) Trailer 20K PSI/20 GPM and components in accordance with the Statement of Work. 

 
	 Period of Performance: 01/04/2027-04/18/2027 (15 Weeks)
	 
		 Option Period of Performance: 04/19/2027 – 05/16/2027 (4 Weeks) 
	 
	 
	 Place of Performance: Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, ME 03904 
 

 Vendors are asked to thoroughly review the attached Statement of Work (SOW) and complete the Combined Synopsis Solicitation including all technical specification information sheets as proposals will be subject to technical evaluation for acceptability. Please send questions to the Point of Contact on this solicitation: Tasha Dooley via email at tasha.l.dooley.civ@us.navy.mil
